label: Robotics Insurance (2025 est.)
hover: Directional estimate of DEDICATED robotics / autonomous-systems insurance premium (~$0.5B). No regulator breaks out a robotics line; syndicated reports quote $0.19-1.4B on undisclosed methodology. Most robot risk sits silently inside product-liability, CGL, workers-comp and cyber books and is NOT counted here.

label: Specialty & emerging-risk carriers
hover: Carriers with explicit AI / autonomous / drone programs (as opposed to silent product-liability exposure).

label: Munich Re / HSB 🇩🇪
hover: HSB launched AI Liability Insurance (2026) paying AI-driven bodily injury / property damage GL often excludes. Tech Trend Radar names humanoids + autonomous mobility as top risk trends. Estimate.

label: Global Aerospace 🇺🇸
hover: Aviation specialty carrier; underwriter behind SkyWatch.AI and a leading writer of commercial drone / UAS hull + liability. Estimate.

label: Tokio Marine Kiln 🇯🇵
hover: Backs MGA Advanced Technology Assurance; writes drone/UAS and cyber for autonomous rail, automated factories, robotics. Estimate.

label: Zurich (YAS embedded) 🇨🇭
hover: Zurich Hong Kong x YAS (2026): bespoke embedded micro-insurance sold at the point of robot sale/service (Axonex robots in logistics, malls, restaurants). First named APAC robot micro-insurance. Estimate.

label: Relm Insurance 🇧🇲
hover: Bermuda emerging-risk carrier; AI liability suite (NOVAAI/PONTAAI/RESCAAI, 2025) covering AI-driven bodily injury, property damage, professional negligence. Estimate.

label: The Hartford (Y-Risk) 🇺🇸
hover: Owns MGA Y-Risk, framed as underwriting the AI and autonomous economy with usage-based, data-fed underwriting. Estimate.

label: Robotics-native MGAs / insurtechs
hover: The only explicitly robot-branded offerings. Small premium, but they define the category and sit on Lloyd's + carrier capacity.

label: Optech Robotics
hover: Up-and-coming robotics MGA out of the Lloyd's Lab accelerator, purpose-built for robot / autonomous-systems risk. Early stage; figure and status company-stated, not independently verified. Est.

label: Koop Technologies 🇺🇸
hover: Industry-first Robotics GL + E&O (2022) with CJ Coleman + Lloyd's syndicates, for off-road AVs / robots / RaaS. API underwriting on robot telemetry. Estimate.

label: SkyWatch.AI 🇺🇸
hover: On-demand drone insurance (up to $10M liability from ~$10/hr), underwritten by Global Aerospace. Marsh McLennan took a minority stake (2025). Estimate.

label: Flock 🇬🇧
hover: UK on-demand commercial drone insurer (~35% of UK commercial drone market); pivoted to connected / autonomous fleets. Raised ~$38M Series B (2023). Estimate.

label: Advanced Tech Assurance 🇬🇧
hover: London MGA backed by Tokio Marine Kiln; cyber + tech cover for unmanned/electric aircraft, AVs, autonomous rail, automated factories, robotics. Estimate.

label: Axis Insurance (robotics) 🇨🇦
hover: Canadian specialty broker/MGA with a dedicated robotics program: BI/PD from AI navigation failure, cyber-takeover damage, downtime from bad updates, integrator liability. Estimate. (Distinct from AXIS Capital.)

label: Vouch 🇺🇸
hover: AI insurance for startups (AI errors, IP, regulatory defense); adjacent cover for robotics / AI startups. Estimate.

label: Reinsurance / capacity
hover: Reinsurers provide the balance sheet and emerging-risk research behind primary robotics programs; robot-branded treaties are rare.

label: Munich Re 🇩🇪
hover: World's largest reinsurer; HSB is its robotics/AI front line. Publishes autonomous-vehicle and robot-liability research. Estimate of robotics-attributable capacity.

label: Swiss Re 🇨🇭
hover: Warns insurers to treat autonomous-AI like silent cyber; partnered with SAS for AI risk intelligence. Estimate.

label: Hannover Re 🇩🇪
hover: Third-largest reinsurer; active in specialty / technology risk. Estimate.

label: SCOR 🇫🇷
hover: French reinsurer engaging autonomous / AI specialty risk. Estimate.

label: Brokers & data enablers
hover: Brokers placing autonomous/robotics risk plus the telematics and risk-scoring firms that make robot underwriting possible.

label: Marsh (drone/robotics desk) 🇺🇸
hover: Largest broker; took a minority stake in SkyWatch.AI (2025) to expand digital drone distribution. Estimate.

label: Aon 🇺🇸
hover: Global broker building autonomous-systems and AI specialty placement. Estimate.

label: Telematics / risk-scoring
hover: Robot black-box / telemetry underwriting: Koop API, SkyWatch telemetry + airspace mapping, Flock connected-fleet data; adjacent fleet vendors (Samsara, Nirvana). Estimate.

label: Claims / TPA specialty
hover: Specialty adjusters handling multi-defendant robot product-liability and bodily-injury claims across OEM / integrator / operator. Estimate.
